title: Samhwa Paint Eco-factory Dashboard
role: Sole publishing owner for all screens; contributed to existing UI-rule improvements
introduction: A dashboard showing process and environmental data for Samhwa Paint’s eco-factory. I handled all screen publishing and aligned the spacing, colors, and layout of cards, charts, and status indicators.
myWorks: Published all client dashboard screens—cards, data areas, status indicators, charts, and informational UI
Unified scattered hierarchy, spacing, and alignment rules into a consistent card-based layout
Codified normal/warning states into color and label rules to make data easier to read
Kept charts and metric areas readable across resolutions with responsive handling
Cleaned up irregular styles and documented shared card, status, and chart UI rules
achievements: Unified spacing, alignment, and status colors that previously differed by screen
Made new widgets follow the same visual rules through shared card and status conventions
points: Consistent cards, charts, and status indicators
